meta.title: Improve Haskell compiler runtime
meta.body_summary: Modify Haskell compiler to avoid importing Aeson unless JSON features are used, split AnyValue runtime from JSON loader runtime, and regenerate machine Haskell outputs with the lighter runtime.

perf_labels.notes: OpenAI_Codex modified Go compiler files and regenerated 32 machine‑generated Haskell test outputs; merged instantly without human review or perf evidence, relying on CI.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 3159 changed lines, this appears large, but the vast majority are machine‑regenerated Haskell test outputs; the core logic changes are only ~27 lines in two Go files. This fits a mechanical, regeneration‑heavy performance PR that was merged instantly.

review_details.performance_claim: Lighten the Haskell runtime by avoiding Aeson import unless JSON features are used and splitting AnyValue from JSON loader.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Modifying compiler code generation and performing bulk regeneration of machine‑generated outputs; maintainer merged without human review, indicating that this class of mechanically reproducible, compiler‑internal change is within the agent‑trust boundary.

detection_detail.ci_auto: Merge occurred immediately after creation; no human review recorded – presumably CI (`go test ./...`) passed, supporting the maintainer’s rapid merge decision.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: No benchmark, profiling, or before/after comparison is provided; only a narrative summary and regenerated test outputs are included.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: No regressions or review issues were raised; the PR was merged without any corrective cycle.

core_change_summary.description: Modified `compiler/x/hs/compiler.go` and `compiler/x/hs/runtime.go` to conditionally import Aeson only when JSON features are used and split AnyValue runtime from JSON loader runtime; then regenerated all machine‑generated Haskell test files under `tests/machine/x/hs/` to reflect the lighter runtime.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: All .hs files under tests/machine/x/hs/ are machine‑generated outputs; the bulk changes are due to runtime adjustments, not manual edits.
change_trajectory: Single commit `hs compiler: remove unnecessary JSON deps` contains all compiler modifications and regenerated test outputs.

collaboration_trajectory: PR opened with compiler modification and regenerated machine outputs; no reviews or comments.
Maintainer merged instantly (within 18 seconds) without any human feedback.
